hints: Insert appends at index size and bubbles UP; extract takes index 0, moves the LAST item into the hole, and sifts DOWN. Two directions, two loops.
parent(i) = (i-1)/2 with integer division. Stop bubbling when i reaches 0 or when the item no longer beats its parent.
Write the before() comparison once and call it everywhere. Inlining the comparison in three places is how the tie-break rule ends up applied in only two of them.
